hypothesis: SF9 combined curriculum widening with much greater name-bearing exposure (144 items/English update, ~4.5x SF8's 32/update); behavioral widening occurred (DEV_SURFACE exact 3->8-9/16, DEV_ORDER exact 2->7-10/16) and D3 rose above the frozen 0.01 ceiling in all three runs by update 100. This study does NOT claim density caused the pollution; it tests the narrower, direct hypothesis that reducing name-bearing exposure toward the historically-tolerated SF8 magnitude allows the SAME widening lesson to continue while D3 stays inside the frozen gate.
manipulated_variable: REDUCED NAME-BEARING CURRICULUM EXPOSURE ONLY. Same SF9 curriculum content (144 items, verbatim, same ids/prompts/tokenizations), same lambda_margin=0.25/M=1.0, same KL/binding/scope/optimizer/LR. The only change: each English update now trains a deterministic 36-item balanced shard (1 of 4) instead of all 144 items, cycled shard 0,1,2,3,... across the 180 English updates so the full curriculum is covered every 4 updates (45 full rotations total).

exposure_comparison.rationale: SF10's per-update batch (36) is chosen to sit close to SF8's known-safe per-update batch (32, ~1.125x), the single most directly comparable exposure metric, while preserving full SF9 curriculum breadth via a fixed balanced rotation. This is a ~4x reduction from SF9 in both per-update density and cumulative per-item exposure. The value was fixed by the curriculum's own structure (144/4=36 exact balanced shards) before any run, not tuned to a target.

parent_rule: Three fresh independent continuations, one per SF8 lambda=0.25 u200 checkpoint, by fixed preregistered seed mapping. NOT continued from the D3-polluted SF9 checkpoints. Fresh optimizer per run (no SF8 or SF9 optimizer state carried).
seed_note: Fresh seeds (not SF9's 87020-87022) to avoid any ambiguity with the D3-polluted SF9 continuations; same SF8 parent checkpoints as SF9 used, mapped in the same order.

margin.note: unchanged from SF8/SF9; hinge on first-answer name token only, full-vocab log-softmax, mean over the 36 sequences in the update's shard

curriculum.source: SF9 TRAIN.json content reused VERBATIM (same 144 items; CURRICULUM.py asserts byte-identical fields except the added 'shard' tag). No redesign of what Baby is taught.
curriculum.shard_assignment: Deterministic, derived only from existing structural identifiers (TRAIN16 pair_id; new-item group+verb+objectkey). Never derived from any observed outcome. 4 shards x 36 items, each shard balanced: name-answer frequency 9/9/9/9, each surface form 4 items, each order:query subgroup 4 items.
curriculum.schedule: English updates cycle shard 0,1,2,3,0,1,... (180 updates = 45 full rotations); binding entries (10,20,...,200) reused verbatim from SF9/SF8/SF1.

english_objective: factual full-vocab CE over answer+EOS (mean supervised tokens, 36-item shard) + lambda=1.0 D_KL(student||Pilot1) over 160 frozen positions + lambda_margin=0.25 * mean(max(0, M - gap)) on first-answer name token. Identical formula to SF8/SF9.
kl_data: unchanged KL_POOL.json 165363 positions/741 rows, 160 per English index 1..180
binding: unchanged pinned answer CE + 1.0536573711078283 hard-min localization; both nonsacred DEV pools
scope: unchanged PINNED_MASKING.set_scope (English = all base_model params except blocks0-3; binding = all)
evaluation: at each update: TRAIN16_RETENTION.json (original 16-item acquisition panel, reused verbatim), DEV_SURFACE.json and DEV_ORDER.json (SF9's NEW development panels, reused verbatim and explicitly treated as HISTORICAL DEVELOPMENT RULERS whose results were already observed once in SF9 - not pristine unseen holdouts), language, D3, both binding pools. Frozen SF1 transfer panels (HELDOUT/ALTERNATE/COPY/COMPETING) are NOT evaluated during training; a single preregistered post-treatment re-evaluation MAY be performed after SF10's classification is frozen, and its result will never be used to adapt SF10.

gates.retention_acquisition: TRAIN16 panel: correct==16 AND exact==16 AND reversals==8 AND families==4 (unchanged acquisition gate; must be preserved)
gates.dev_surface: DEV_SURFACE: forced-choice correct>=15/16 AND greedy exact>=13/16
gates.dev_order: DEV_ORDER: greedy exact>=13/16 AND fact-query exact>=7/8 AND copy-query exact>=7/8
gates.continue: retention_acquisition AND language AND d3 AND binding pass at 100/200; regression stop otherwise
gates.endpoint_pass: update 200 AND continue AND dev_surface AND dev_order

gates_unchanged_confirmation: Verified byte-for-byte against sf9_surface_order_curriculum_v1/PROTOCOL.json gates block before writing this file. No threshold moved.
stopping: No rescue. No density change mid-run. No example addition. Each run stops at 200 or on a frozen 100/200 regression. Other independent runs continue after any one run's stop.
mechanical_hygiene: Runs are launched exactly once each, sequentially, in the foreground (no detached/background process ambiguity as occurred in SF9).
An explicit run ledger (seed, PID/tool-call, start/end, outcome) is kept in the final report.

REPORTER.py is written and smoke-tested against a synthetic no-training fixture BEFORE sealing, and is verified compatible with the actual update0-only baseline artifacts (no update0_GATES.json is produced by the controller; REPORTER does not require it).
REPORTER.py is never modified after SEAL.
transfer: HELDOUT/ALTERNATE/COPY/COMPETING remain LOCKED during training. FINAL/sacred never accessed.
numerical_uncertainty: N=3 independent parent replications; no population claim.

study_interpretation.DENSITY_HYPOTHESIS_SUPPORTED: >=2 of 3 runs reach u200 with D3<=.01 throughout AND make further widening progress versus SF9 (dev_surface/dev_order exact strictly greater than SF9's observed 8-9/16 and 7-10/16 respectively at the same update), regardless of whether the full endpoint_pass gate is met
study_interpretation.DENSITY_HYPOTHESIS_SUPPORTED_FULL_ENDPOI: >=2 of 3 runs reach u200 and satisfy the complete endpoint_pass gate
study_interpretation.DENSITY_HYPOTHESIS_WEAKENED: D3 again exceeds .01 in >=2 of 3 runs despite reduced exposure
study_interpretation.DENSITY_HYPOTHESIS_UNRESOLVED_WIDENING_S: D3 stays <=.01 but dev_surface/dev_order show no material improvement over parent baseline
study_interpretation.RETENTION_REGRESSION: priority if TRAIN16/language/binding regress in >=1 run
study_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE_EARLY_STOP: priority if a mechanical failure (not a scientific gate) halts a run

history: SF1-SF9 classifications unchanged and unmodified. SF9 remains sealed; its D3-polluted checkpoints are not reused as parents here.
